So test that calling getEntry after calling operate with same index again does not replace entry. Also test that entry remains same after calling getExit (should not affect entry). We need to avoid duplication. Provide new groups: Position.getEntry after operate called multiple times, Position.getEntry after exit trade set, Position.getEntry idempotency, Position.getEntry after serialization/deserialization, Position.getEntry after cloning.

But we don't have code for serialization; we can assume Position implements Serializable, so we can serialize and deserialize and then getEntry should still be same trade (or equal). Provide test case.

Also test that getEntry returns the exact same reference (not a copy) by checking identity.

Case 2: after entry set, call operate to set exit (i.e., close position). getEntry should still return original entry trade (not null). Expected same instance.

Case 3: call getEntry multiple times, ensure same reference each time.

Case 4: serialize Position to byte array and deserialize; getEntry should return a Trade equal to original (maybe same values). Since after serialization, object identity changes, but equality should hold. Expected: a Trade with same properties (price, amount, type). So expected "equal trade".
